title: Count business days between two dates with a holiday list
levels: Meets every requirement in the brief
Misses at least one requirement in the brief

cases.rationale: It subtracts holidays that fall on a weekend, so 2026-12-21 to 2026-12-31 with the Saturday 2026-12-26 as a holiday returns 7 instead of 8.
It walks the dates after start through end, skips weekends and a deduplicated holiday set, and negates the count for reversed ranges.
Weekday counts from the proleptic ordinal give the exact count after start through end, minus distinct weekday holidays in that range, negated when reversed.
It subtracts a holiday once per listing, so [date(2026, 12, 25), date(2026, 12, 25)] gives 6 instead of 7, while the pasted log claims the duplicate-holiday test passed.
